context: Evaluates whether the agent detects a near-duplicate/overlapping rule against the existing file and offers amendment before defaulting to a second entry.

checklist.name: Reads existing rules before acting
checklist.description: The existing rules file is read and the near-duplicate rule is located before any decision is made

checklist.name: Surfaces the overlap explicitly
checklist.description: The agent explicitly tells the user the new request overlaps with an existing rule rather than silently proceeding

checklist.name: Suggests amending over duplicating
checklist.description: Amending the existing rule is offered as the default suggestion rather than immediately appending a second entry

checklist.name: New entry only with confirmation
checklist.description: A genuinely separate new entry is only created if the user confirms it's warranted after seeing the overlap

checklist.name: Existing rule not silently altered
checklist.description: The existing rule is not deleted or rewritten without the user's explicit input
